blocks.text: The later bill is $27.39 every month.
The first parcel is five dollars and thirty one cents. The single parcel choice is the other line, and it is not the one marked.
The host is the shop you opened. No packing line is added. Felt pads is not ticked. Cotton percale sheet, queen is a single item unless the repeat stays marked.
Weekend orders placed before noon leave the stockroom the same day.

product.description: The sheet is cotton percale sized for a queen bed.
product.name: Cotton percale sheet, queen

trick.evidence_text: The lower figure is only the first parcel. Later bills are $27.39 every month.
trick.instruction: Pick the single parcel line and turn the repeat off before you pay.
